rationale: The original short thesis relied on price failing to reclaim the 5-minute 9-EMA ($173.91), which has now been decisively breached to the upside. Furthermore, the latest 1-minute bar shows a strong bullish impulse on a massive volume spike (48,157 shares vs ~2,000-5,000 on prior bars) pushing price right up to session VWAP ($174.50). Closing now cuts the loss early before the automatic invalidation at $174.85 is triggered by this buying momentum, while avoiding a flip to long directly into VWAP resistance during a weak broader market (SPY -1.52%).
